high.title: USD Nearly Reaches IDR 18,000, Purbaya Says Many Negative Issues in Market
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya addresses the significant rupiah weakening against USD, attributing it to various negative rumors circulating in financial markets. The USD has approached IDR 18,000 level, representing a critical threshold for Indonesian currency stability.

high.title: IHSG Suddenly Plunges 4% to 5,946
high.summary: Indonesian stock index (IHSG) experienced sudden dramatic fall of over 4% during trading session, dropping from 6,200+ level to below 6,000. This represents significant market volatility affecting investor portfolios.

high.title: Root Cause of IHSG Sudden Collapse to 5,900
high.summary: IHSG closed down nearly 5% due to pressure on rupiah exchange rate and several Indonesian economic indicators showing slowdown. The index hit lowest level at 5,841.99 during trading, representing major market correction.

high.title: Purbaya Opens Up: USD Breaks IDR 18,000, I Leave It to BI
high.summary: Finance Minister confirms USD has breached IDR 18,000 level but delegates exchange rate management to Bank Indonesia. This represents a psychological threshold breach that could impact import costs and inflation expectations.

high.title: Rupiah Falls, IHSG Weakens - Palace: Our Economic Fundamentals Are Strong
high.summary: Government maintains confidence in strong economic fundamentals despite significant weakening in both rupiah and stock market. IHSG has corrected 32.46% year-to-date while USD reached IDR 18,049 level.

high.title: What's Behind IHSG's Nearly 5% Collapse
high.summary: Market analysts attribute IHSG's dramatic decline to rupiah weakening and deteriorating Indonesian economic data. The currency weakness is creating significant pressure on Indonesian equities and investor sentiment.

high.title: Rupiah Collapse Threatens Thousands of Workers with Layoffs, Mostly from This Sector
high.summary: CORE Indonesia projects additional 15,300-20,300 workers could face layoffs due to rupiah weakness increasing import costs and disrupting business operations. Manufacturing sector expected to be most affected with potential 8,700-12,100 job losses.

medium.title: Following Orient Express Model, KAI Launches Luxury Train Nusantara Explorer July 1
medium.summary: State railway company KAI launches premium tourism train service inspired by Europe's Orient Express, connecting Jakarta, Yogyakarta, Semarang, and Banyuwangi. This targets niche luxury tourism market with premium pricing strategy.

medium.title: KAI-INKA Merger to Complete This Year
medium.summary: State-owned railway companies KAI and INKA will complete merger this year under government directive for SOE efficiency. KAI will serve as holding company while INKA becomes sub-holding in the restructured entity.

medium.title: Kimia Farma Turns Loss into Profit of IDR 123.63 Billion
medium.summary: State pharmaceutical company Kimia Farma reports strong Q1 2026 turnaround with IDR 123.63 billion net profit after previous year losses of IDR 443.35 billion. Company achieved IDR 2.03 trillion in net revenue showing operational recovery.

medium.title: Asuransi Astra Confident Performance Will Continue Growing - Here's Why
medium.summary: Asuransi Astra remains optimistic about growth prospects despite rupiah pressure and rising interest rates. Company's limited USD exposure and diversified portfolio provide resilience against current market volatility.

medium.title: New BGN Head's 4 Breakthrough Moves for MBG Budget Efficiency
medium.summary: New National Nutrition Agency head implements budget efficiency measures, cutting allocation from IDR 335 trillion to IDR 268 trillion while maintaining program beneficiary targets. Focus on refocusing beneficiaries and improving management systems.

medium.title: Unilever Distributes IDR 4.32 Trillion Dividend End of June
medium.summary: Unilever Indonesia announces final dividend distribution of IDR 4.32 trillion for 2025, part of total IDR 7.63 trillion dividend package. Company reported net sales of IDR 31.9 trillion and net profit of IDR 3.5 trillion in 2025.

medium.title: Several Aspects Experience Growth, Alfamart Distributes IDR 1.7 Trillion Dividend
medium.summary: Alfamart approves dividend distribution of approximately IDR 1.7 trillion or IDR 41.5 per share based on strong 2025 performance. The retail chain reports growth across multiple business aspects supporting dividend decision.

medium.title: Indonesian Government Bonds Resilient Amid Global Turmoil - Here Are the Factors
medium.summary: Deputy Finance Minister claims Indonesian government bond market remains resilient despite global volatility, supported by policy credibility and stable domestic investor base. Government maintains 3% fiscal deficit limit commitment.

medium.title: Painful to See Red Portfolio, What Should Investors Do
medium.summary: Market analysts advise investors not to panic during IHSG decline, recommending focus on fundamental analysis rather than emotional selling. Investors urged to remain disciplined and selective during market correction.
